fields.name: no
fields.note: wish number e.g. 0001, also the id in addresses

fields.name: link
fields.note: last part of /w/<link>; may be empty until paid (UI tests !w.link)

fields.name: ticket
fields.note: moment|keepsake|signature|premiere or empty string when not paid

fields.name: endsAt
fields.note: optional; absent means term counts from first open

fields.name: amount
fields.note: naira number as in the code (fixture), e.g. 312000

actions.name: actOnWish
actions.evidence: POST /v1/admin/wishes/:no/actions { action, reason } -> WishDetail. Written to the audit log with the staff member and reason.

effects.restore: state -> live (term not ended) / resting (ended) / sealed (no endsAt)
effects.extend: endsAt + 7 days (GOODWILL_DAYS=7) from later of now and endsAt; resting -> live
effects.resend: a Message 'The link, sent again by staff' to the sender's email
effects.refund: the wish's paid tickets payment -> refunding (not_allowed if none)

actions.availability: offered by state: take_down for live/sealed/resting; restore for down; extend for live/resting; resend for live/sealed with a link; refund when a paid tickets payment exists and wish not draft (the UI computes this client-side in wishActions; server must decide it)

authContext.note: Shell redirects to /admin/sign-in when useStaff() is null (components/admin/Shell.tsx:~64). The code does not gate this screen by role; roles are those whose access list (lib/admin/d-fixtures.ts:113-121) includes this path.

special.note: not_found error when wish no unknown; each action opens a confirm sheet that needs a reason of 4+ characters

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: error (not_found 'That is not here.', or failed)
uiStatesHandled.note: unknown wish number in the address is reachable

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: Confirm onConfirm throws -> 'That did not go through.'
